item.title: Alligator Energy Prepares for Field Recovery Trials after Commissioning of Samphire Uranium Pilot Plant
item.description: Alligator Energy (ASX: AGE) completes Samphire uranium pilot plant commissioning on schedule; energise plant and begin 4-month field recovery trials.

item.title: Encounter Resources Unveils Significant Niobium and REE Extensions at Green Prospect, Eyes 2026 MRE Update
item.description: Encounter Resources (ASX: ENR) has unveiled a significant expansion of high-grade niobium mineralisation to over 4km strike at its Green prospect.

item.title: Javelin Minerals Identifies New Anomalies at Coogee Gold Project from Historical Exploration Data
item.description: Javelin Minerals uncovers new geophysical anomalies at Coogee gold project; targets aircore drilling after $4.5m raise, near St Ives, WA.

item.title: Solvar H1 FY26 NPAT Rises 5.8% Amid NZ Exit and Funding Boost
item.description: Solvar NPAT up 5.8% in H1 FY26 as it accelerates NZ exit, secures $488m warehouse facility, boosting funding to ~$1.1b and announcing dividends.

item.title: EV Resources Produces First Antimony Ingots Using High-Grade Ore from Los Lirios
item.description: EV Resources produces first antimony ingots from Los Lirios ore, de-risking toward a near-term primary producer in Mexico via mine-to-metal.

item.title: American West Metals Taps US Government Advisor for Critical West Desert Indium Project
item.description: American West Metals taps US government advisor to advance West Desert indium, targeting Defense Production Act funding and a US mine-to-market supply chain.

item.title: Sports Entertainment Group Posts Strong H1 FY26, Raises FY26 Guidance
item.description: SEG beats H1 FY26, revenue $73.7m, EBITDA up 78% to $11.9m; upgrades FY26 EBITDA growth to at least 40% after Perth Wildcats sale nets $12m cash.

item.title: Cleo Diagnostics Selects Next-Generation Ella Platform to Deliver Ovarian Cancer Blood Test
item.description: Cleo Diagnostics (ASX:COV) selects Bio-Techne's Ella ELISA platform to run its ovarian cancer test, advancing toward FDA 510(k) filing and supply deal.

item.title: IDT Australia Reports Operational Improvements with New Leadership Team and Realignment Strategy
item.description: IDT Australia (ASX: IDT) reports improving six-month ops under a new leadership team and realignment strategy; revenue up 20% to $8.4m, EBITDA losses narrowed.

item.title: Cyclopharm Secures NIH Approval for Technegas, Boosting US Expansion
item.description: Cyclopharm wins NIH approval for Technegas, secures US purchase order; installation under FSS imminent as funding targets 250-300 US installs by H2 2026.
